# Copilot Instructions

This repository follows the central policy at:
.github/instructions/agent-governance-policy.instructions.md

All coding-agent runs must comply with that policy.

## Required Delivery Standard

1. Work in safe, scoped slices.
2. Run targeted validation after each meaningful change.
3. Apply secret hygiene and avoid exposing sensitive values.
4. Keep user-facing behavior clear and professional.
5. Report objective, files changed, validation evidence, and remaining risk.
